capture_rule: Capture the complete accepted-manuscript primary article and every source row, column, note, uncertainty and declared experimental condition in every complete article table whose caption or header reports measured OH plus ethanol or OH plus propan-2-ol rate coefficients paired with temperature. Preserve both registered reactions, every reported temperature class, every repeated condition row and every favorable, lower, nonmonotone or otherwise adverse observation in source order. Do not select by trend or agreement and do not fit, import or infer an Arrhenius, exponential, logarithmic, prefactor or activation relation.
source_selection_boundary: The DOI, complete primary article, both named measured reactions and the exhaustive caption/header rule are fixed before the article PDF opens, before executable-law registration, before candidate enumeration and before prediction-program construction. The source is selected structurally because one openly accessible primary measurement article reports complete experimental temperature/rate series for both reactions with method and condition provenance. No observed row value, trend, fitted expression or desired agreement selects the source, tables, rows or Fold law.

sources.measurement_body: American Chemical Society, Journal of Physical Chemistry A primary research article; accepted manuscript preserved by White Rose Research Online
sources.title: Measurements of Rate Coefficients for Reactions of OH with Ethanol and Propan-2-ol at Very Low Temperatures
sources.capture_scope: complete accepted manuscript and every complete source table row reporting measured rate coefficient paired with temperature for either named reaction, including all uncertainties, densities or pressures, methods, notes and repeated conditions
